name: Tordillos (Spain)
description: Square flag vertically divided red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Tordillos (a tower on blue and a red saltire above a cauldron on white).
history: The arms of Tordillos were published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 30 May 1996; the municipal flag was approved on 30 October 1996 and is square, gules on its dexter side and azure on the sinister, charged with the council's arms.
